claim.quote: Precise measurements of the spin structure functions of the proton $g_1^p(x,Q^2)$ and deuteron $g_1^d(x,Q^2)$ are presented over the kinematic range $0.0041 \leq x \leq 0.9$ and $0.18 $ GeV$^2$ $\leq Q^2 \leq 20$ GeV$^2$.

name: HERMES precise determination of the spin structure function g1 of the proton, deuteron and neutron

summary.plain: HERMES measured how the proton's and deuteron's spin is carried by quarks, with high precision over a wide range of momentum fraction, using polarised positrons on polarised hydrogen and deuterium gas, and derived the neutron's spin structure function.
summary.technical: Precise measurements of g1^p(x,Q^2) and g1^d(x,Q^2) over 0.0041 <= x <= 0.9 and 0.18 <= Q^2 <= 20 GeV^2 in deep-inelastic scattering of 27.6 GeV longitudinally polarised positrons off longitudinally polarised hydrogen and deuterium gas targets internal to HERA, using 1996-97 proton and 2000 deuteron data; combined with g1^d to give g1^n.

title: Precise determination of the spin structure function g1 of the proton, deuteron and neutron
why_it_matters: g1 fixes how much of the nucleon spin is carried by quark spins; its first moment is a central input to the proton spin puzzle.
